name: Squarespace Commerce
description: Squarespace Commerce APIs for one site: orders and fulfillment with tracking, inventory levels and stock adjustments, products and variants, customer profiles and contacts, and financial transactions. API key bearer.
instructions:
## Squarespace Commerce
This connector works with the **Squarespace Commerce APIs** at `https://api.squarespace.com` for one Squarespace site: orders and fulfillment, inventory, products (read), profiles and contacts (customers and subscribers) and financial transactions.

**Setup (about 3 minutes)**
1. Log in to the Squarespace site. In the left navigation open **Settings**, scroll to **Advanced** and click **Developer API Keys**. API keys need a **Commerce Advanced** plan.
2. Click **Generate key**, name it, and choose the permissions: Orders (Read and Write to fulfill), Inventory (Read and Write to change stock), Products (Read Only), Profiles, Contacts and Transactions (Read Only).
3. Copy the key into `SQUARESPACE_API_KEY`. Squarespace shows it only once; it does not expire while the site is active.

Every call carries `Authorization: Bearer` with the key and a `User-Agent` header, which Squarespace requires.

**Where to start**: `squarespace_commerce_get_website` to confirm the site, then `squarespace_commerce_list_orders` with `fulfillment_status` PENDING for orders to ship.

**Orders**: `squarespace_commerce_list_orders`, `squarespace_commerce_get_order`, and `squarespace_commerce_fulfill_order` (adds shipments with tracking and marks the order fulfilled; can email the customer). Use the order `id` in calls; `orderNumber` is what the customer sees. Refunds and cancellations are not part of the API.

**Inventory**: `squarespace_commerce_list_inventory`, `squarespace_commerce_get_inventory`, `squarespace_commerce_adjust_inventory`. Every adjustment needs a fresh `idempotency_key` (a UUID): resending the same key does nothing, which makes retries safe.

**Products**: `squarespace_commerce_list_products` and `squarespace_commerce_get_products` (Products API v2: types PHYSICAL, SERVICE, GIFT_CARD and DIGITAL; prices and stock on each variant). Product changes are not included.

**People**: `squarespace_commerce_list_contacts`, `squarespace_commerce_search_contacts`, `squarespace_commerce_get_contact` (Contacts API) and the older `squarespace_commerce_list_profiles`, `squarespace_commerce_get_profiles` (Profiles API, in maintenance mode but still the one with order totals per customer).

**Money**: `squarespace_commerce_list_transactions` and `squarespace_commerce_get_transactions` read payments, refunds and fees per order or donation; nothing here moves money.

**Paging and dates**: lists return up to 50 records with `pagination.hasNextPage` and `pagination.nextPageCursor`; pass the cursor alone to get the next page. `modified_after` and `modified_before` must be given together and are UTC ISO 8601. Money values are objects with `currency` and `value` (a decimal string). Get-by-id tools take up to 50 ids separated by commas.

**Rate limit**: 300 requests per minute per key; above that Squarespace answers 429 and blocks the key for one minute.

SQUARESPACE_API_KEY.label: API key
SQUARESPACE_API_KEY.help: Squarespace, Settings, Advanced, Developer API Keys: generate a key with the Commerce API permissions you need and copy it (shown once).
SQUARESPACE_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste only the API key, without Bearer and without spaces.

401.hint: Squarespace refused the API key. Generate a new key under Settings, Advanced, Developer API Keys and paste it; a key is shown only once.

verifyHints.403: The key works but lacks the permission for this API. Generate a key with Read (or Read and Write) for Orders, Inventory, Products, Profiles, Contacts or Transactions as needed.
verifyHints.404: Squarespace found no order, product, variant, profile or transaction with that id.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Squarespace allows 300 requests per minute per key and then blocks it for one minute. Wait a minute and try again.

prerequisites: A Squarespace site on the Commerce Advanced plan (needed for Developer API Keys) and an owner or admin who can generate keys. About 3 minutes.

tools.name: squarespace_commerce_get_website
tools.description: Read basic information about the Squarespace site the API key belongs to: id, siteTitle, url, timeZone, currency, language and location. Needs no particular permission; a cheap check of the key.

tools.name: squarespace_commerce_list_orders
tools.description: List orders, most recently modified first, 50 per page: id, orderNumber, createdOn, modifiedOn, channel, customerEmail, customerId, billingAddress, shippingAddress, fulfillmentStatus, lineItems (productName, sku, variantOptions, quantity, unitPricePaid), subtotal, shippingTotal, taxTotal, refundedTotal, grandTotal, fulfillments and formSubmission. Next page via pagination.nextPageCursor while hasNextPage is true.

payment_states.description: Comma-separated payment states: NOT_CHARGED, AUTHORIZED, PAID, REFUNDED, PENDING, FAILED, REFUND_PENDING, REFUND_FAILED, PARTIALLY_PAID. Default NOT_CHARGED, AUTHORIZED, PAID and REFUNDED.

customer_id.description: Only orders of this customer id (customerId of an order or a profile id).

modified_after.description: Only records modified after this UTC time, ISO 8601 such as 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z. Needs modified_before too; cannot be used with cursor.

modified_before.description: Only records modified before this UTC time, ISO 8601. Needs modified_after too; cannot be used with cursor.

cursor.description: Cursor of the next page: pagination.nextPageCursor of the previous answer. Send it alone; it cannot be combined with the other filters.

tools.name: squarespace_commerce_get_order
tools.description: Read one order by id: the same fields as squarespace_commerce_list_orders, with all line items, discounts, internal notes and fulfillments.

order_id.description: Order id (id of squarespace_commerce_list_orders, not orderNumber), a 24-character id such as 585d498fdee9f31a60284a38.

tools.name: squarespace_commerce_fulfill_order
tools.description: Mark an order as fulfilled and add shipments with ship date, carrier, service, tracking number and tracking URL. should_send_notification true emails the customer. Answers 204; 409 when the order is already fulfilled or canceled.

order_id.description: Order id, a 24-character id such as 585d498fdee9f31a60284a38.

should_send_notification.description: true: email the customer the shipment details.

shipments.description: Shipments, each with shipDate (ISO 8601 UTC), carrierName, service, trackingNumber and trackingUrl. Can be empty to only mark the order fulfilled.

tools.name: squarespace_commerce_list_inventory
tools.description: List stock for all product variants, 50 per page: variantId, sku, descriptor (product name and options), isUnlimited and quantity. Next page via pagination.nextPageCursor.

cursor.description: Cursor of the next page: pagination.nextPageCursor of the previous answer.

tools.name: squarespace_commerce_get_inventory
tools.description: Read real-time stock of specific variants: variantId, sku, descriptor, isUnlimited and quantity.

variant_ids.description: One variant id or up to 50 separated by commas.

tools.name: squarespace_commerce_adjust_inventory
tools.description: Change stock of variants in one call: increment or decrement by a quantity, set a finite quantity, or make variants unlimited. Needs a unique idempotency_key per change: repeating a key repeats nothing. Answers 204; 409 when a decrement would go below zero.

idempotency_key.description: A new random value per adjustment, e.g. a UUID. Reusing it makes Squarespace skip the call as already done.

set_finite_operations.description: Set stock to an exact quantity: variantId and quantity.

tools.name: squarespace_commerce_list_products
tools.description: List products, 50 per page: id, type (PHYSICAL, SERVICE, GIFT_CARD, DIGITAL), storePageId, name, description, url, urlSlug, tags, isVisible, createdOn, modifiedOn, variants (id, sku, pricing with basePrice and salePrice, stock) and images. Next page via pagination.nextPageCursor.

type.description: Comma-separated product types: PHYSICAL, SERVICE, GIFT_CARD, DIGITAL.

modified_after.description: Only records modified after this UTC time, ISO 8601 such as 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z. Needs modified_before too; cannot be used with cursor.

modified_before.description: Only records modified before this UTC time, ISO 8601. Needs modified_after too; cannot be used with cursor.

cursor.description: Cursor of the next page: pagination.nextPageCursor of the previous answer. Send it alone; it cannot be combined with the other filters.

tools.name: squarespace_commerce_get_products
tools.description: Read up to 50 products by id with their variants, pricing, stock, attributes and images.

product_ids.description: One product id or up to 50 separated by commas.

tools.name: squarespace_commerce_list_profiles
tools.description: List profiles (customers, mailing list subscribers, donors), 50 per page: id, firstName, lastName, email, hasAccount, isCustomer, createdOn, address, acceptsMarketing and transactionsSummary (order count, totals). The Profiles API is in maintenance mode; the contacts tools are its successor.

filter.description: Semicolon-separated filters: `isCustomer,true`, `hasAccount,true` or `email,someone@example.com` (email cannot be combined with the others).

cursor.description: Cursor of the next page: pagination.nextPageCursor. Cannot be combined with other parameters.

tools.name: squarespace_commerce_get_profiles
tools.description: Read up to 50 profiles by id: names, email, address, marketing consent and transactionsSummary.

profile_ids.description: One profile id or up to 50 separated by commas.

tools.name: squarespace_commerce_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (the successor of profiles): id, firstName, lastName, email, phone, createdOn, defaultShippingAddress and marketing preferences. Up to 1000 per page; next page via pagination.nextPageCursor.

cursor.description: Cursor of the next page: pagination.nextPageCursor of the previous answer.

tools.name: squarespace_commerce_search_contacts
tools.description: Search contacts by name or email text, sorted as asked: the same fields as squarespace_commerce_list_contacts. Read-only although it is a POST.

search_string.description: Text matched against name and email.

cursor.description: Cursor of the next page: pagination.nextPageCursor.

tools.name: squarespace_commerce_get_contact
tools.description: Read one contact: names, email, phone, addresses and marketing preferences.

contact_id.description: Contact id, a 24-character id such as 585d498fdee9f31a60284a38.

tools.name: squarespace_commerce_list_transactions
tools.description: List financial transactions grouped per order or donation (a document), 50 per page: id, createdOn, modifiedOn, customerEmail, salesOrderId or donationId, total, totalSales, totalNetSales, totalNetPayment, totalTaxes, payments (provider, amount, refunds, processingFees) and salesLineItems. Read-only.

modified_after.description: Only documents modified after this UTC time, ISO 8601.

modified_before.description: Only documents modified before this UTC time, ISO 8601.

cursor.description: Cursor of the next page: pagination.nextPageCursor.

tools.name: squarespace_commerce_get_transactions
tools.description: Read up to 50 transaction documents by id, with payments, refunds, fees and line items. Read-only.

document_ids.description: One transaction document id or up to 50 separated by commas.
